description: NATIVE-0001 scenario registry. `kind` is `automated` (Record-Baseline.ps1 can run it as-is), `assisted` (launch or seed by hand, then measure with -AttachPid), or `manual` (needs in-app instrumentation that does not exist yet; see README coverage matrix).

notes: Synthetic load validating the sampler itself: expect peak commit of at least ~120 MB from a single pwsh process.

attach.prepare: pnpm build:forge:sea (or pnpm dev:forge for a dev build)

notes: Forge idle memory is a Phase-0 required baseline; record on the named Windows test machine after a fresh start, no threads open.

attach.launch: electron .dist/desktop/main.js (cold: clear %LOCALAPPDATA% artisan home first per README procedure)
attach.findRoot: the electron root pid spawned by the launch

notes: Cold/warm distinction comes from whether the Forge home existed before launch. Startup wall-clock to first interactive frame needs the desktop instrumentation tracked in the README coverage matrix.

scenarios.blockedBy: frame/input instrumentation hooks in the desktop shell
scripted thread-fixture seeding and desktop instrumentation
protocol-level probe client emitting timestamped events through the real transport
